slides.headline: DECODE THE JOB DESCRIPTION
slides.body: What recruiters write vs what they actually screen for.

slides.headline: MOST APPLICANTS SKIM IT
slides.body: Then they send the same resume to every role. The JD is the marking scheme. Read it like one.

visual.label: a skim like this misses the screen
visual.note: illustrative: how long a skim really takes

slides.headline: FIND THE MUST-HAVES
slides.body: Must-haves sit in the first bullets and repeat. Nice-to-haves say preferred.

slides.headline: SCORE YOUR FIT
slides.body: Tick each must-have you can prove with a project. Under half? Skip it.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS
slides.body: Open it next to the next JD you read.

caption:
